description: A high-backed, egg-shaped chair with a swivel base. The chair is upholstered in a textured, light brown fabric and features a dark trim around its edges. It comes with two attached cushions: one small rectangular cushion at the top and a larger, more substantial cushion for the seat. The base of the chair is a smooth, white, tulip-shaped pedestal, giving it a modern and sculptural appearance. The overall design is sleek and contemporary, offering a comfortable and stylish seating option.
